pages.title: Moving speakers
pages.text: On Minecraft 1.21.1, optional Sable support updates sound position and facing on moving bodies. Sable Companion is bundled; Sable itself is separate.

pages.title: Coordinate links
pages.text: Exact proxy-coordinate links must be updated if the proxy changes block position. Sable support is unavailable on 1.20.1 and 26.1.2.
